_about.purpose: Labelled corpus for measuring scorer accuracy, calibration and fairness. Replayed by `python -m app.evaluate`.
_about.labelling: expected_winner is a human judgement by the project author, not adjudicated ground truth. Cases a careful reader cannot decide on the evidence alone are labelled null and excluded from accuracy; they are reported separately as the abstention set.
_about.difficulty: clear = one side is obviously right | contested = both sides have real evidence | adversarial = constructed to break a specific heuristic | unarbitrable = not decidable on the evidence

cases.claim_text: I never received this espresso machine. The tracking shows it wasn't even shipped.
evidence: Label created 2026-06-01. Carrier has not scanned the package since. Status: not shipped.
cases.rationale: Carrier never scanned the parcel; merchant cannot show shipment.

cases.claim_text: Card member claims non-receipt, but tracking shows delivery.
evidence: Package delivered to 12 Pine Ave, Rivertown, signed by M. Torres.
cases.rationale: Delivered to the address on file and signed by the card member by name.

cases.claim_text: I never got my order; the shipping address on the label doesn't even match mine.
evidence: Package delivered to 200 Birch Court, Millbrook, signed by unknown recipient.
cases.rationale: Delivered to a different address entirely, signed by an unnamed recipient.

cases.claim_text: I returned this laptop stand three weeks ago and still haven't been refunded.
evidence: Our return policy allows returns within 30 days for a full refund.
cases.rationale: Merchant's own policy permits the refund and none was issued.

cases.claim_text: I want a refund but the merchant says no refunds are given.
evidence: All sales are final. No refunds or exchanges under any circumstances.
cases.rationale: Disclosed final-sale policy and no allegation the goods were faulty.

cases.claim_text: The produce box I received was moldy and nothing like the photos.
evidence: Customer support: We're sorry for the inconvenience, we'll look into this.
cases.rationale: Perishable goods claim the merchant never rebutted; support acknowledged contact but produced no counter-evidence.

cases.claim_text: This item wasn't what I ordered.
cases.rationale: No evidence from either party. Provisional credit is a policy choice, not a finding of fact.

cases.claim_text: I was charged twice for the same order.
evidence: Order confirmation email received once, dated 2026-06-10.
cases.rationale: One order confirmation against two charges, and the merchant produced nothing.

cases.claim_text: Merchant claims delivery but I never got anything, and the address doesn't match at all.
evidence: Delivered to 900 Industrial Pkwy, Warehouse District, signed by Receiving Dept.
cases.rationale: Delivered to a commercial address unrelated to the card member, signed by a role rather than a person.

cases.claim_text: Tracking shows it's still in transit, but it's been a month.
evidence: Package scanned at regional facility 2026-05-20, in transit to destination.
cases.rationale: In transit for over a month with no further scan; non-delivery is the reasonable inference.

cases.claim_text: Merchant admitted the item was defective in chat but never refunded me.
evidence: We apologize for the defective unit and will process this for you.
Refunds are provided within 14 days for defective items.
cases.rationale: Merchant admitted the defect and its own policy mandates a refund that was never issued.

cases.claim_text: Package was returned to sender apparently, but I was home all day.
evidence: Package returned to sender after failed delivery attempt.
cases.rationale: Goods went back to the merchant, so the card member paid for nothing.

cases.claim_text: Item arrived damaged and merchant provided a photo showing packaging was fine.
evidence: Photo shows the shipping box fully intact with no visible damage.
cases.rationale: Only positive evidence is the merchant's intact-packaging photo; the card member produced nothing.

cases.claim_text: Charged twice, and merchant already refunded one charge via email confirmation.
evidence: We've confirmed and refunded the duplicate charge as requested. Sorry for the trouble!
cases.rationale: The duplicate was already refunded. Awarding the card member here is a double refund; the apology must not read as an unremedied admission.

cases.claim_text: Item shows delivered and signed, but the box was empty when I opened it.
evidence: Delivered to 3 Hemlock Row, Bayview, signed by A. Stone.
I did receive a package but it was empty when I opened it.
cases.rationale: A signature proves a box arrived, not its contents. Neither party can prove the contents; this needs a human.

cases.claim_text: Never arrived. The tracking address is not my building.
evidence: Delivered to 99 Pine Ave, Rivertown, signed by unknown recipient.
cases.rationale: Same street and city, different building, plus a generic signee. Token-overlap address matching scores this for the merchant.

cases.claim_text: This was delivered to a completely different state.
evidence: Delivered to 5 Elm St, Denver, signed by R. Patel.
cases.rationale: Different street and different city. Shares only the house number and 'st', which token overlap treats as a match.

cases.claim_text: Carrier left it somewhere without any signature and I never found it.
evidence: Attempted delivery to 40 Harbor Rd, Seaford. Not signed by anyone.
cases.rationale: Negated signature. The old regex extracted 'Anyone' as a signee and awarded delivery confirmation.

cases.claim_text: I was billed twice for one order.
evidence: You were charged twice in error. The second charge has been refunded in full on 2026-06-14.
cases.rationale: Merchant admits the duplicate but has already remedied it. Upholding the dispute would refund the card member twice.

cases.claim_text: They refuse to help me and I never got the part.
evidence: Sorry, we cannot help you. Our records show the item was delivered correctly.
Delivered to 7 Kingsway, Ashgrove, signed by I. Chan.
cases.rationale: A polite denial is not an admission. Delivery to the address on file, signed by the card member, is decisive.

cases.claim_text: The vase arrived shattered into pieces.
evidence: Photo shows the ceramic vase shattered into several pieces inside the box.
Order placed 2026-06-02. Ship to 16 Foxglove Ln, Weatherby.
cases.rationale: Direct photographic evidence of damage from the card member, with a matching receipt.

cases.claim_text: They will not refund me for a clearance item I changed my mind about.
evidence: Clearance items are final sale. We do not offer refunds on clearance stock.
cases.rationale: Explicit no-refund wording. Substring matching on 'no refund' alone misreads several phrasings of this.

cases.claim_text: They sent the wrong model and admitted it, but never fixed it.
evidence: Our error. We shipped the wrong item and have not yet arranged a replacement.
cases.rationale: A genuine admission of fault containing no apology wording, which keyword matching on 'sorry' misses entirely.

cases.claim_text: The tracking is too vague to tell where this went.
evidence: Delivered to Dunmore 41022, signed by M. Hale.
cases.rationale: Address is unparseable and must award neither side, but the signature matches the card member by name and carries the case.

cases.claim_text: The sealed box was delivered but the headphones inside were counterfeit.
evidence: Delivered to 60 Alder Cres, Kingsmere, signed by Y. Sultan.
The box arrived sealed but what is inside is not the product I paid for.
cases.rationale: Delivery is undisputed; the dispute is about contents and authenticity, which neither party can evidence here.
